items.title: Recurring Payments (SEPA & Card)
items.summary: New feature enabling automated monthly charges via SEPA Direct Debit or credit card — designed for long-stay, co-living, memberships, and recurring billing. Set once, Mews handles the rest.
items.pitch: Recurring Payments lets properties automate monthly guest charges directly in Mews using SEPA Direct Debit or credit cards. Instead of manually chasing repeat payments, teams can set up a payment plan once and let Mews handle the rest — reducing admin effort, improving payment reliability, and creating more predictable revenue.

items.title: New Mews Terminal Hardware Portfolio (A1–A4)
items.summary: Four new PCI PTS 6 certified payment terminal models now available via Mews Marketplace — covering front desk, self-service, and fully unattended kiosk setups.
items.pitch: Mews now offers a complete payment terminal portfolio for every hospitality setup. Customers can order PCI PTS 6 certified terminals directly from the Mews Marketplace, with pre-configured hardware that works out of the box and supports everything from traditional front desks to self-service kiosks.

items.title: Auto-Email Balanced Bills at Checkout
items.summary: Mews now automatically emails balanced bills closed during check-out — completing the full billing automation journey. Company-level opt-outs and flexible settings available.
items.pitch: Automated billing now goes all the way through to bill delivery. Once enabled, Mews can automatically email balanced bills that are closed during check-out, reducing manual tasks and helping guests and companies receive their final bill faster.

items.title: Upload Budget, Forecast & Historical Data in Mews BI
items.summary: Revenue managers can now upload planning data into Mews BI and compare it against actual performance in a single dashboard — no more manual exports and spreadsheet merging.
items.pitch: If you're comparing performance against budgets or forecasts, you no longer need to export data and piece everything together manually. You can upload your planning data into Mews BI and see it alongside actual performance.

items.title: Support Cases Directly in Mews Operations
items.summary: Properties can now view, track, and reply to Mews support cases directly inside Mews Operations — no more inbox-switching. Admins see all property cases; standard users see their own.
items.pitch: If you've ever had to dig through your inbox to find a reply from support, this changes that. Your support cases are now listed directly in Mews Operations, under the user menu.

items.title: Export Event Products to Mews Operations (Multiple Times)
items.summary: Event teams can now re-export products from Mews Events to Mews Operations as many times as needed when a quote changes — keeping billing aligned with final event details.
items.pitch: Event details rarely stay the same from the first quote to the final invoice. Now, when a quote changes, you can export updated products to Mews Operations without starting over.

items.title: Clearer Security Overview in Mews Operations
items.summary: Refreshed Security overview with simplified ratings, actionable recommendations, and updated scoring aligned with current standards.

items.title: Flexible Allowances (per night / per guest / per guest per night)
items.summary: Allowances now support per-night, per-guest, or per-guest-per-night configuration, plus the ability to edit or delete allowances — for corporate credits, packages, and complex upsell strategies.
items.pitch: Allowances are now a much more powerful and flexible tool. Whether you're offering daily dining credits, managing long-stay corporate agreements, or updating guest entitlements, you can configure and maintain allowances in a way that matches your property's real-world operations.

items.title: Invoice Automation
items.summary: Automatically issue and send invoices at checkout via Billing Automation — no more manual invoice issuance at the front desk. Blitz testing completed June 12; pilot approaching.

items.title: Customer-Led Digital Key Onboarding & Kiosk Per-Guest Keys
items.summary: Guests self-onboard digital keys; kiosks will support per-guest key issuance. Announced in FOH TOI for the next 30-day window.

items.title: Mews Events: Business on the Books Report & Flexible Posting
items.summary: Business on the Books reporting for pipeline visibility plus flexible posting in Mews Events. In the FOH 30-day pipeline.

items.title: HMS Smart Auto-Assign for Work Allocation
items.summary: Housekeeping Management System gains smart auto-assign for work allocation. Moving into closed beta per FOH TOI.

items.title: Groups: Availability Block Reports, Rule Inheritance & Multiple Occupancies
items.summary: Groups gains availability block reports, rule inheritance, multiple occupancy support, and improved merge behaviour — in the upcoming 30-day FOH window.

items.title: Reservations Module Redesign
items.summary: Full redesign of the Reservations module with phased rollout. Timeline detailed in FOH TOI June 2026.

items.title: AI Bug Bot — Autonomous End-to-End Production Bug Fixing
items.summary: Agentic pipeline (Moxly + Claude) takes production errors from Coralogix triage to a validated fix PR with no human in the loop. First real bug fixed unattended: AGT-1690 (RedisClusterException). Multi-repo roadmap ahead.
items.segmentation: Currently scoped to agt-core; multi-repo on roadmap

items.title: Mews Identity — IdP for the Full Hospitality Stack
items.summary: Long-term vision: Mews as the identity provider for hotel staff across the entire hospitality tech stack beyond just Mews products. Two tracks: Log in with Mews SSO + email provisioning. Discovery phase underway.
